name: Disable Samsung TV Plus
description: 1.1.0 no longer masks or kills slive-provider-daemon: it is Type=dbus with BusName=com.samsung.FCCallListener, and masking a bus-name owner leaves callers waiting for an owner that can never appear (the measured cause of a 2-3 s remote-key dead zone when data-service was masked; see samsung-telemetry-off 1.4.0). TV Plus still stays off because the player (bms-service), the setting and the boot flag are what this module removes; the lineup fetcher is left idle. It also unmasks slive and its triggers on apply so an upgraded boot heals without a reboot. Turns off 'Autorun Samsung TV Plus' (db/menu/autorun_tv_plus), clears the boot-into-TV-Plus flag, masks the TV Plus backend (bms-service, slive-util channel dump) and reaps the standalone TV Plus app via a supervised 30s watchdog. Disable via the manager or the disabled flag; revival needs a reboot.
author: Clément Péron
